name: influxdb-cli
description: influxdb-cli — InfluxDB CLI client. Query time-series data, manage buckets, write data from command line.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/influxdata/influx-cli/releases/latest/download/influx_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf influx_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv influx /usr/local/bin/ && rm influx_linux_amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub or official packages.

commands.description: influxdb-cli — InfluxDB CLI client. Query time-series data, manage buckets, write data from command line.
